arguments.message: 建立裙樓、入口與下段塔身的可編輯玻璃、窗框及屋頂

plan.method: Editable projected 2D faces and per-panel surface grids in centimetres, scale1, azimuth35/elevation25. Full isolated building on transparent canvas; measured total height, explicitly estimated secondary dimensions. Separate podium/base, eight tiers and crown/spire with continuous projection and lighting.
references: Oneness & Associates Taipei 101 project: overall508m, bamboo tier and ornament descriptions.
Structural Design of Taipei101, Evergreen Consulting Engineering: structural configuration.
Secondary dimensions are reconstruction estimates, not complete survey.

whole.requirement: Entire Taipei101 base to spire, distinctive silhouette, no broad schematic simplification.
whole.description: Complete isolated architectural illustration including eight projecting bamboo tiers and visible base/crown.

view.requirement: Fixed elevated three-quarter view with visible top surfaces and consistent perspective.
view.description: All visible surfaces obey one projection and painter order.

detail.requirement: Highly detailed facade structure, window frames and visible ornamentation.
detail.description: Editable panels, mullions, spandrels, recesses, tier ledges, ornaments, crown and spire detail.

material.description: Green-blue reflective glazing, metal highlights, stone and self-shadow under projections.

scale.requirement: Real-world dimensions at1cm=1px before perspective; projected lengths reflect angle.
scale.description: 50800cm ground-to-tip; scale1 world centimetres with consistent angular projection, explicit estimates for unmeasured secondary dimensions.

editable.description: Native editable vectors, gradients and panel shapes, no raster flattening.

brief.intent: Entire detailed Taipei101 reconstructed at centimetre scale.
brief.viewpoint: Fixed orthographic elevated three-quarter 35° azimuth25° elevation.
assumptions: Base63.5m, taper to45.5m at118m and podium footprint estimated; no survey-grade claim.
